answer: Quadratic stake bonding: the n-th identity tied to one funding source must lock n squared times 2 POA, so the fifth costs 50 and ten fakes tie up 770 POA. Bonds release only after 24 epochs. Where a meadow of near-identical wallets appears, a crystal-clear graph audit flags any cluster sharing a funder, and a challenger who proves it on a knoll of public ledger data wins 40 percent of the slashed bond.
